<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 520 480" width="520" height="480">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Grid and Axes Group -->
  <g transform="translate(70, 40)">
    
    <!-- Grid lines (vertical, every 2 units from 2 to 14 -> 7 lines) -->
    <!-- Scale: 1 unit = 25px. Width = 14 * 25 = 350px -->
    <!-- Height: 100 units = 350px -> 1 unit = 3.5px -->
    
    <line x1="50" y1="0" x2="50" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="100" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="0" x2="150" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="200" y1="0" x2="200" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="250" y1="0" x2="250" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="0" x2="300" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="0" x2="350" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Grid lines (horizontal, every 20 units from 20 to 80 -> 4 lines) -->
    <line x1="0" y1="70" x2="350" y2="70" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="140" x2="350" y2="140" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="210" x2="350" y2="210" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="280" x2="350" y2="280" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Axes -->
    <line x1="0" y1="350" x2="370" y2="350" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="350" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- X-axis Ticks and Labels -->
    <!-- 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 -->
    <!-- Positions: 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350 -->
    <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="0" y="370">0</text>
      <line x1="0" y1="350" x2="0" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="50" y="370">2</text>
      <line x1="50" y1="350" x2="50" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="100" y="370">4</text>
      <line x1="100" y1="350" x2="100" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="150" y="370">6</text>
      <line x1="150" y1="350" x2="150" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="200" y="370">8</text>
      <line x1="200" y1="350" x2="200" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="250" y="370">10</text>
      <line x1="250" y1="350" x2="250" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="300" y="370">12</text>
      <line x1="300" y1="350" x2="300" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="350" y="370">14</text>
      <line x1="350" y1="350" x2="350" y2="355" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Y-axis Ticks and Labels -->
    <!-- 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 -->
    <!-- Positions: 350, 280, 210, 140, 70, 0 -->
    <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">
      <text x="-10" y="350">0</text>
      <line x1="-5" y1="350" x2="0" y2="350" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="-10" y="280">20</text>
      <line x1="-5" y1="280" x2="0" y2="280" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="-10" y="210">40</text>
      <line x1="-5" y1="210" x2="0" y2="210" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="-10" y="140">60</text>
      <line x1="-5" y1="140" x2="0" y2="140" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="-10" y="70">80</text>
      <line x1="-5" y1="70" x2="0" y2="70" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <text x="-10" y="0">100</text>
      <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="0" y2="0" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Axis Titles -->
    <text x="175" y="410" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">partial pressure of oxygen / kPa</text>
    
    <text x="-175" y="-50" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90)">saturation of haemoglobin / %</text>

    <!-- Curves -->
    <!-- Curve A (Solid, reaches 50% at ~3.5 kPa i.e x=87.5, y=175) -->
    <!-- Starts near (0,350), sigmoid shape, flattens near y=10-20 -->
    <path d="M 0 350 C 60 350, 70 230, 87.5 175 C 105 120, 150 25, 350 15" 
          fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Curve B (Dashed, shifted right, reaches 50% at ~4.8 kPa i.e x=120, y=175) -->
    <!-- Starts near (0,350), sigmoid shape, flattens near y=15-25 -->
    <path d="M 0 350 C 80 350, 95 240, 120 175 C 145 110, 185 30, 350 20" 
          fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>

    <!-- Curve Labels -->
    <text x="320" y="5" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">A</text>
    <text x="320" y="38" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">B</text>

  </g>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="260" y="460" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 7.1</text>

</svg>
